newsitem.title: UK: MAID shares gain on talk of news product.
newsitem.headline: MAID shares gain on talk of news product.

text.p: Shares in electronic information group Maid rose on Monday after a weekend press report said the group is planning to undercut rivals' financial news services with a new innovative screen-based product.
Shares in Maid were up 10-1/2p to 310p by 0730 GMT but had been indicated 22p higher in pre-market trade.

Analysts said the report probably had substance but the new products were unlikely to be compete with the real-time information systems developed by international news and information group Reuters Holdings Plc and financial information group Bloomberg LP.
"About three-quarters of Maid's client base is non-financial," said Andy Yeo, media analyst at ABN Amro Hoare Govett.
"Maid's existing clients would also like a real-time share price service and Maid are reacting to this," he added.
"Such new services would be excellent news for Maid and fair value for the shares would clearly be more than three pounds a share." Yeo said.
